name: Home, again friendly pastel
summary: A friendly, readable pastel register for Home, again: cream canvas, warm white surfaces, mint/peach/lavender/sky/butter tints, a coral signal and a plotter-blue second accent, softly rounded 8 to 12 px corners with one flat 1 px lip of elevation, Pretendard sans for body, headings and buttons at 16 px on a 1.5 line, near-black ink and clearly darker borders. Dark mode keeps a deep plum-navy with the same pastel signals but is not used this round.
use_when: Home, again: a friendly pastel interface floating over a full-screen voxel neighbourhood
avoid_when: dense all-day tables where a calmer graphite register fits better
signature: Pretendard everywhere: body, headings, buttons and labels at a 16 px base on a 1.5 line; JetBrains Mono only for small numbers and metrics
bold sentence-case headings: no forced uppercase on headings, labels, table heads or nav groups
soft pastel structure: 8 to 12 px corners, panels with a clear 1 px dark border and one flat 1 px lip (no blur, no glow), mint/peach/lavender/sky tints for featured blocks
high contrast on cream: near-black ink (16:1), secondary text at 7:1 or more, component edges at 3:1 or more, a deep-blue focus ring
plain panel heads: a title and a status on the panel surface, no inverse bars
a coral signal on the primary action and the figure that matters, plotter blue on the second series and the user's home; calm short motion with a gentle press
forbid: square instrument costume: inverse panel bars, 3 px rules, bracketed coordinates, terminal prompts, scanlines
uppercase headings, uppercase labels or wide letter-spacing on running text
blurred or soft drop shadows, glow, glassmorphism and gradients (DS-007 reports shadows off the flat lock)
rainbow charts, more than four accent hue families in one view, or decorative emoji
text below 13 px or below 4.5:1 contrast, and touch targets below 44 px
